H1.sentence: CaR improves answer accuracy by up to +13.3% (abstract); 'On challenging datasets like GPQA-Diamond and AIME-2025, CaR improves performance by up to +13.3' (§4.2)
H1.loc: abstract p.1; §4.2 p.5; Table 1 p.5 (Distill-Qwen-14B, AIME-2025)
H1.n_unit: items (AIME 2025 I+II problems; not stated in the paper; values are k/30: 16/30 and 12/30)

headline.H2: CaR improves accuracy while reducing reasoning length by 40-50% (abstract; §4.2 p.5)

notes: 'Up to +13.3' in the abstract matches two cells (14B AIME-2025; QwQ-32B AIME-2024); Table 1 also contains +15.0 (7B AMC-2023), so the abstract's maximum refers to the 'challenging datasets' named in §4.2. Some values are not consistent with the standard benchmark sizes (QwQ-32B AIME-2023 69.7 is not k/30; GPQA 5.7 is not k/198), which suggests averaging or different n; not resolvable from the paper.
